title: CreditNote
description: A Credit note (Canonical Model document, version 1): Finance's correction of one line of an issued Shipper invoice, in full or in part, with a reason. The ERP, which owns Credit notes, issues it and publishes it in CreditNoteIssued. Final once issued: it is never changed or deleted, and the invoice it credits is left as it was.

creditNoteNumber.description: CN-<year>-<6 digits>, from its own gapless sequence per calendar year, taken only in the transaction that issues the Credit note.

creditNoteDate.description: The day the Credit note was issued, Europe/Amsterdam.

shipper.description: The Shipper of the credited invoice, from the ERP's seed-loaded Shipper data.

transportOrderNumber.description: The Transport Order number of the invoice line credited, which identifies the line within its invoice.

shipperReference.description: The Shipper's own reference for the credited line's Transport Order.

shipmentNumber.description: Kept for Finance. It isn't sent to the Shipper (ADR 0011).

deliveryDate.description: The day the credited line's Shipment was Delivered, where it happened.

totalWithoutVat.description: The amount credited, without VAT: above zero and at most the line's total minus the earlier Credit notes on that line.

vat.description: 21% of the amount credited, rounded to cents, half away from zero.

totalWithVat.description: The amount credited and the VAT added up.

reason.description: Why Finance credited the line, for example "Rate Card error on Lane NL-BE, see ticket 4411". Required.

correlationId.description: The correlation ID the ERP created for this Credit note.
